messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
Insurers may widen the scope of the product but in no case the scope of the product can be narrowed down. II. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number: 1. “Ayushman Bharat Health Account” (ABHA) number is a hassle-free method of accessing and sharing health records digitally. It enables interaction with participating healthcare providers, and allows to receive digital lab reports, prescriptions and diagnosis seamlessly from verified healthcare professionals and health service providers. 2. With specific consent of the policyholder, Insurers may facilitate creation of ABHA number as per procedures laid down. 3. Further, express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance. III. Submission of Returns:
"""

Passage B:
"""
Chapter III Miscellaneous Provisions: I. Model Product for Persons with Disabilities, Persons afflicted with HIV/AIDS and those with Mental Illness II. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number III. Submission of Returns IV. Repeal of Guidelines and Circulars 17 17 17 17 Effective date: (1) This Master circular shall come into force with immediate effect except for provisions where specific effective date is mentioned. (2) The existing products which are not complying with the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024 and this Master Circular shall be modified on or before 30.09.2024. Revision in terms and conditions of the products that are warranted exclusively due to the application of any of the updated provisions contained in this circular or the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations,2024 shall be carried out under the extant UIN, with the approval of Product Management Committee(PMC).
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Can an insurer create an Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number for a policyholder who is covered under the new model product for persons with disabilities, and what consent is required?","answer":"Yes, the insurer can create an ABHA number for a policyholder covered under the model product for persons with disabilities, provided the policyholder gives express consent for the creation of the ABHA number and for sharing medical records in each instance.","facts_a":["Insurers may facilitate creation of ABHA number as per procedures laid down","express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance"],"facts_b":["Model Product for Persons with Disabilities"],"sub_queries":["ABHA creation consent","model product for persons with disabilities"]}]}
